subject: First-mile procurement: DPA, SOC 2 link, and PO instructions
messages:
From: John Miller <john.miller@atlas-payments.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier kick-off: vendor activation + compliance docs

Hi Priyom / Monica,

We are ready to move Atlas Payments through your vendor activation. Procurement asked me to collect the following before procurement will issue a PO:
- DPA (signed or countersigned)
- Current SOC 2 Type II report (or a link to a hosted copy)
- Current subprocessor list (CSV or spreadsheet)
- PO instructions (who to send invoice to, billing address, tax EIN)

I filled out the vendor intake form and attached it here (Vendor_Intake_Atlas_20270330.pdf). Can you confirm what format you prefer for the subprocessor list and whether you require DocuSign or an uploaded signed PDF for the DPA? Also let me know an estimated timeline so we can schedule the PO.

Thanks,
John Miller
Head of Partnerships | Atlas Payments
john.miller@atlas-payments.com
(415) 555-0198

Attachment: Vendor_Intake_Atlas_20270330.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: John Miller <john.miller@atlas-payments.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Supplier kick-off: vendor activation + compliance docs

Hi John — thanks for the intake and the clear list. Looping in Laura from procurement for PO routing.

Quick answers and next steps:
- DPA: attached is our standard DPA (Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf). We can send a DocuSign envelope if you prefer countersign. If Atlas would rather sign a PDF and upload it, that works too.
- SOC 2: live link to our Type II report is in the attached text file (SOC2-Type2-Redwood-link.txt) — it's a protected URL; we can add your domain for access if needed.
- Subprocessors: we maintain a CSV export (subprocessors_list_202703.csv). If you need a filter by region/data type, tell me and we'll generate it.
- PO: Laura will confirm the PO flow; typical timeline is 3–5 business days after DPA acceptance and receipt of billing/legal info.

Next actions for Atlas:
1) Confirm whether you want DocuSign or PDF upload for the DPA.
2) Share billing address and tax info (Priya flagged below).

I'll attach the DPA and the subprocessor CSV for your review.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwood.com

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf; subprocessors_list_202703.csv; SOC2-Type2-Redwood-link.txt

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@atlas-payments.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 16:37:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Supplier kick-off: vendor activation + compliance docs

Thanks Priyom — received the DPA and files. A couple quick items: 

1) Subprocessor list: CSV is great. Can you include a column for whether the subprocessor handles cardholder data or PII? That will speed up our legal review.
2) DPA signing: DocuSign is easiest for us. Please send an envelope to priya.shah@atlas-payments.com.
3) Billing info attached (Atlas_Billing_Info.pdf) — billing address + remit-to + EIN. Confirm whether Redwood needs a separate W-9 (we're US-based).

If we can get the DocuSign DPA and the amended subprocessor CSV by EOD Thursday (Mar 31), procurement will start the PO the same day.

Best,
Priya Shah
Finance Operations Manager | Atlas Payments
priya.shah@atlas-payments.com

Attachment: Atlas_Billing_Info.pdf

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@atlas-payments.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 31 Mar 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Supplier kick-off: vendor activation + compliance docs

Hi Priya — Laura from Procurement here. Thanks for the billing info — that looks fine. A few notes on PO and timeline: 

- PO routing: we require the signed DPA and a completed vendor intake (which you already filed). Once we have the signed DPA we will create PO RDW-12478 and route it to your Accounts Receivable contact for acceptance.
- Terms: standard net-30 unless otherwise negotiated. If Atlas needs net-45/60, please flag and we'll escalate.
- W-9: yes, please upload a W-9 to our secure intake portal (link below) or email it to procurement@redwood.com (secure link preferred).
- Portal + PO instructions: https://redwood-procurement.example.com/vendor-portal (use the PO_Instructions_v2.pdf I've attached for step-by-step).

If you can confirm DocuSign preference and upload the W-9 by COB Thursday, we will target issuing the PO on Thursday afternoon.

Thanks — looping Monica for any technical gating items (e.g., subprocessor column for PII).

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Procurement Lead | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

Attachment: PO_Instructions_v2.pdf
